## Behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Keep the scope tied to balanced postings, retry identity and journal/valuation replay.

## Evidence

Include a minimal synthetic example or an independently calculated expectation when behavior changes. Explain any intentional contract, compatibility or saved-evidence change; do not refresh expected outputs merely to make a verifier pass.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results using [the contribution guide](https://github.com/dev-belly/LedgerX/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). For documentation or configuration changes, record link/YAML checks instead of unrelated model runs. State checks that could not run and why.

## Data and boundaries

Confirm that added examples can be published and retain their source attribution. Include the prior head checkpoint if one was independently retained, input row order and expected balances. Do not publish real transaction journals.
